title: Concept: OGNL template error returned to a client
description: A OGNL template error with its file and line in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The expression text and the failure mode are the feedback an attacker needs to build a working OGNL payload against the same stack.
applicability: Deployments that render a OGNL template error with its file and line into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The expression text and the failure mode are the feedback an attacker needs to build a working OGNL payload against the same stack.
